title: KYC of Directors holding a DIN (Form DIR-3 KYC / DIR-3 KYC-WEB)
rules: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014, Rule 12A
subject: DIRECTOR

periodicity.note: CORRECTION from an earlier draft of this obligation: DIR-3 KYC is filed EVERY YEAR by every DIN holder, due 30 September following the financial year — it is not triennial. An earlier version of this file called it MCA.DIR3KYC.TRIENNIAL, which was wrong, and has been replaced by this one. Still DRAFT: confirm current MCA circular treatment (eForm vs web-form eligibility) with a CS before shipping.

penalty: DIN marked 'Deactivated'; Rs.5,000 fee to reactivate.
